save_clipboard_image: save a clipboard image to a destination path as PNG on macOS, Windows, Linux, or WSL2
has_clipboard_image: check whether the system clipboard currently contains image data without extracting it
extract_clipboard_image_windows: extract an image from the Windows clipboard using PowerShell and save it as PNG
extract_clipboard_image_linux_wayland: extract an image from a Wayland clipboard using wl-paste and convert BMP to PNG if needed
convert_clipboard_bmp_to_png: convert a BMP image file from a Wayland clipboard to PNG using Pillow or ImageMagick
